matches.rationale: No finding mentions a fabricated citation [39] or a non-existent foundational paper for adaptive temporal windowing in the Introduction.
No finding identifies the logical inconsistency in Equation (4) of the MoT module where softmax mixing breaks normalization.

Finding 1 detects the unreported error-threshold filtering that enhances apparent performance, matching the filtering issue. Finding 2 detects inconsistent training years across sections, matching the contradictory data-years problem.
No finding calls out the exaggerated 'first model' claim in the abstract; none mention prior work achieving sub-daily resolution.
No finding discusses Figure 4's suspiciously large RMSE margin or physically unlikely error gaps relative to operational systems.
No finding addresses the conclusion's rhetorical exaggeration of outperforming operational systems without mentioning limitations.
No finding points out the overstatement that multi-step loss mitigates error accumulation, despite visible error growth in figures.
No finding notes the absence of uncertainty quantification or confidence intervals in the evaluation against observations.
No finding mentions the mismatch between selecting 20 vertical layers and the dataset's 40-layer structure or the missing justification.

Finding 3 explicitly notes Figure 5's axis labels and scales for salinity and temperature RMSE are inconsistent with expected oceanographic ranges, directly matching the evidence integrity issue with those figures.

Finding 4 points out that the abstract claims superior/competitive skill for multiple variables across depths but validation was only for SST, which is the same underlying overstatement described in the ground truth.
No finding identifies the appendix's omission of a comprehensive discussion of risks from reanalysis data biases.
No finding discusses the selective emphasis on low-error regions in spatial error maps while downplaying high-error western boundary currents.
No finding mentions the unusually low effective batch size of 4 or its potential to cause unstable training.
No finding points out the unfair comparison to other models trained on later data while FuXi-Ocean uses older data, or the inconsistency in the related-work context.
No finding addresses the conclusion's overgeneralization that 6-hour forecasts confirm effectiveness across all variables and scales.
No finding calls out the phrase 'operational tolerance thresholds' as downplaying known deficiencies in western boundary current regions.
